title: Aurum Alpha job invocation
description: standards/057-jobs.md JB1: the input of a job started by a tick, a deployment step, or an operator. It is deliberately not a CloudEvent (057 Decisions): a CloudEvent is a past-tense fact about an entity with a public id, and none of these triggers is that. The attribute names are borrowed so a job sees one shape either way. The worker constructs it (035 WK4); a job never builds its own. The key is derived by the trigger's rule and carried, so the job does not derive it: tick -> '<job>@<tick_at>', deployment -> '<job>@<version>', operator -> the key supplied, else '<job>@<id>'. For a per-event job the input is the 055 AM1 envelope itself and the key is '<source>:<id>'.

id.description: Minted by the worker for this invocation. Also the run id.

source.description: The service, named logically as 055 AM1 names it: /invoicing.

trigger.description: The three invocation triggers. A message is the fourth trigger and arrives as an event, not an invocation.

traceparent.description: Started by the worker or handed to it in the environment (040 OC1).

key.description: 057 JB2's key, derived by the trigger's rule.

args.description: The job's arguments, validated by the worker against the declaration's args_schema before the body runs.

tick_at.description: tick only: the scheduled instant, supplied by the runner as --at. Two firings of one tick share it and therefore share a key.

version.description: deployment only: the release version being deployed.

operator.description: operator only: who ran it, as the audit standard would name the actor.
